description: FHIR MCP server with SMART Backend Services, response compaction, FHIRPath, and guarded writes.
name: io.github.faulkj/fhirhydrant

environmentVariables.description: Run the installed package over MCP stdio.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: FHIR authentication mode. Use none only for an unauthenticated FHIR endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: Full base URL of the FHIR API, such as https://fhir.example.org/fhir/R4.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.description: SMART Backend Services token endpoint. Required when FHIR_AUTH=smart unless it can be derived from FHIR_BASE_URL.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_TOKEN_URL

environmentVariables.description: SMART Backend Services client ID. Required when FHIR_AUTH=smart.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded PKCS#8 private signing key. Required when FHIR_AUTH=smart.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_ACTIVE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Externally reachable JWKS URL for the signing key. Recommended for SMART authentication over stdio.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_JWKS_URL

environmentVariables.description: FHIR release used for FHIRPath and response shaping.
environmentVariables.name: FHIR_VERSION
